description: By Ashlee Banks, Special to the AFRO, The San Diego Voice & Viewpoint, March 2, 2026Rev. Jesse Jackson Sr., the civil rights titan and two-time presidential candidate who rose from the Jim Crow era to the heights of American political influence, will return to his native South Carolina on March 2. Jackson will lie in state at the State House Rotunda in Columbia, S.C.The homecoming, announced by Gov.
